rows.source: NHS Patient safety incident response standards
rows.verified: The current standards are version 1.3, updated in January 2026.

rows.source: NHS Patient Safety Incident Response Framework
rows.verified: PSIRF establishes systems and processes for responding to incidents for learning and improving patient safety.

rows.source: NHS Patient Safety Incident Response Framework
rows.verified: Patient safety incidents include unintended or unexpected events and omissions that could have or did cause harm.

rows.source: NHS Patient Safety Incident Response Framework
rows.verified: PSIRF replaced the 2015 Serious Incident Framework.

rows.source: NHS Patient Safety Incident Response Framework
rows.verified: PSIRF makes no separate category distinction between patient safety incidents and Serious Incidents.

rows.source: NHS Patient safety incident response standards
rows.verified: The standards set the minimum expectations organisations should meet under PSIRF.

rows.source: NHS Patient safety incident response standards
rows.verified: The standards cover policy, planning, oversight, competence, engagement, proportionate responses and safety improvement.

rows.source: NHS Patient safety incident response standards
rows.verified: The January 2026 revision amended training requirements for people in oversight roles.

rows.source: NHS Never Events policy and framework
rows.verified: The existing Never Events framework remains active while an alternative approach is developed.

rows.source: NHS Never Events policy and framework
rows.verified: Providers must continue recording qualifying Never Events in LFPSE.

rows.source: NHS Never Events policy and framework
rows.verified: Learning responses to Never Events must be undertaken in line with PSIRF.

rows.source: NHS Never Events policy and framework
rows.verified: Never Events are defined as wholly preventable incidents where strong national systemic barriers should have been implemented.

rows.source: NHS Never Events policy and framework
rows.verified: The policy applies to NHS-funded care.

rows.source: NHS patient safety data 2025-26
rows.verified: Quarter 4 patient safety event data for January to March 2026 was released on 11 June 2026.

rows.source: NHS patient safety data 2025-26
rows.verified: Quarter 3 data was released on 12 March 2026 and corrected on 7 April 2026.

rows.source: NHS patient safety data 2025-26
rows.verified: The 2025/26 Never Events summary is explicitly provisional.

rows.source: NHS provisional report of Never Events
rows.verified: The report covering events between 1 April and 31 May 2026 was updated and published on 9 July 2026.

rows.source: NHS Never Events policy and framework
rows.verified: Consultation findings initiated discovery work for a replacement approach, so the future framework is not yet final.

rows.source: NHS patient safety data 2025-26
rows.verified: Patient safety event counts measure recorded reports and should not be interpreted as provider risk rates without activity and reporting-context denominators.

rows.source: NHS Patient Safety Incident Response Framework
rows.verified: Patient safety reports describe healthcare systems and events and do not measure parcel-level public safety.
